name: codex-advisor
description: Codex-native Astra advice and authorized Architect work with Luna or Astra implementation, explicit Sol selection, and independent Astra review.

interface.shortDescription: Use Astra advice or authorize Architect work with delegated implementation.
interface.longDescription: Codex Advisor lets non-Astra primary agents implement work with Astra advice at consequential decisions and multi-step completion. Explicitly authorized Astra architects delegate bounded implementation to Luna at max and demanding or higher-risk implementation to Astra at medium. Sol is available when explicitly selected by the user, defaulting to high. Architects inspect actual changes and rerun key checks. High-risk work and user review requests add a fresh Astra Independent reviewer at the required effort floor. Astra remains available for ordinary solo work. Primary model and effort remain user-owned; missing or conflicting required routing evidence pauses the affected step.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-advisor:orchestration to implement and verify this feature.
Consult the Astra Advisor at the required boundaries while preserving my primary model and reasoning effort.
